args.content:
LANDSCAPE INVENTORY:
Systems: corp.itsm, emarsys.cx, my.mes, sap.ariba, sap.crm, sap.ehs, sap.odm, sap.s4, sap.sf, siemens.plm, workday.hcm

KEY FINDINGS BY FUNCTION:
- STAFFING & CAPABILITY ANALYSIS: sap.sf:agent:SkillsAndCapabilityMatchingOrchestrator:v1
- CAMPAIGN SAFETY & ENGAGEMENT: emarsys.cx:agent:IncidentComplianceOrchestrator:v1
- PAYROLL & COMPENSATION: sap.sf:apiResource:EmployeeCompensationManagement:v1
- PRODUCT ECONOMICS: sap.s4:agent:ProcurementMatchingAgent:v1
- PRODUCTION SCHEDULES: my.mes:apiResource:EquipmentOEEAnalytics:v1

VENDOR SAFETY COMPLIANCE & PROCUREMENT:
- VENDOR SAFETY VERIFICATION: sap.ehs:agent:VendorComplianceAutomationOrchestrator:v1
- HAZARD TRACKING (supplier): sap.ariba:agent:SupplierComplianceAndIncidentMonitor:v1

MATERIAL EXPENSES & SUPPLIER COMPLIANCE:
- INVOICE RECONCILIATION: sap.ariba:agent:VendorInvoiceReconciliationAutomation:v1
- SUPPLIER QUALITY & COMPLIANCE: my.mes:agent:SupplierQualityComplianceOrchestrator:v1

PART SPECS vs SUPPLIER CERTIFICATIONS:
- PART SPECS vs SUPPLIER CERTIFICATIONS: sap.s4:agent:BOMComplianceAutomationAgent:v1
- PRODUCTION BOM COMPLIANCE: my.mes:agent:BillOfMaterialsComplianceValidator:v1

SAFETY INCIDENT ANALYSIS & TRENDS:
- INCIDENT ANALYSIS & TRENDS: sap.ehs:agent:IncidentRootCauseAnalyzer:v1
  * Analyzes safety incidents to identify root causes across enterprise
  * Generates structured RCA reports with corrective/preventive actions
  * Processes SafetyIncident entity types
  * Works across all manufacturing sites (enterprise-wide analysis)

EQUIPMENT UPGRADES & ASSET TRACKING FOR AUDIT READINESS:
- ASSET PROVISIONING & CHANGE COORDINATION: corp.itsm:agent:AssetProvisioningOrchestrator:v1
  * Coordinates IT asset lifecycle provisioning across engineering changes
  * Orchestrates equipment assignment and allocation across organizational units
  * Tracks material movements and product item assignments to change orders
  * Automates provisioning workflows with audit trail maintenance (implicit ITSM requirement)
  * Handles cross-department asset coordination for change initiatives
  * Processes EngineeringChange, Material, ProductItem entity types

args.reason: Coordinates IT asset lifecycle provisioning with change automation across departments, maintains audit trails through ITSM workflows, and orchestrates equipment assignment tracking for change initiatives.

method_trace.picked_reason: Coordinates IT asset lifecycle provisioning with change automation across departments, maintains audit trails through ITSM workflows, and orchestrates equipment assignment tracking for change initiatives.

intent_resolver.reason: The user is requesting two separate, distinct workflows (payroll/benefits review and equipment upgrade tracking) that don't form a single cohesive process; proc_018 covers compensation review but no skill covers equipment upgrade lifecycle management end-to-end.

sub_queries: Pull together our current payroll structure and benefit allocations for the upcoming fiscal review
Log and track equipment upgrades we're rolling out across departments to stay audit-ready
